description.value:
You touch an object, and it immediately disassembles itself into its component pieces. The spell fails if the target lacks component pieces (such as a statue carved from one block of stone), and using it on a dangerous object like a snare or trap typically triggers it. The object gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Broken] condition, and the component pieces become small enough to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Hidden] under normal clothing and armor. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dismiss] the spell.

When the spell ends, the object reassembles itself into its original form, appearing in your hand or hands if you have them free, or on the ground in front of you otherwise. Once reassembled, the object loses the Broken condition and its Hit Points return to the value the object had when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Cast a Spell]{Cast the Spell}.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts for 10 minutes.

Heightened (6th) The spell lasts until your next daily preparations.

target.value: 1 non-magical object in your possession of 1 Bulk or less

description.value:
You create a small explosion of bright light and ear-piercing sound that rocks the senses. Creatures in the area take sonic damage with a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines the damage and other parameters.

1 This spell deals 1d10 sonic damage, and its area is a 5-foot square. Creatures that fail their save become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Dazzled] until the end of your next turn.

2 This spell deals 2d10 sonic damage, and its area is a 10-foot burst. Creatures that fail their save become dazzled until the end of your next turn.

3 This spell deals 2d10 sonic damage, and its area is a 20-foot burst. Creatures that fail their save become dazzled and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Deafened] until the end of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10 for all versions.

You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

target.value: 1 spell effect or unattended magic item

description.value:
The palm of your hand grows a mouth with impossibly long fangs that ache to drink your enemies' blood. Make a melee spell attack against a target. On a hit, you deal 4d4 piercing damage and 2 persistent bleed damage (or double damage on a critical hit). For the duration of the spell, you regain @Damage[(max(2,@item.rank))[vitality,healing]|shortLabel] Hit Points each time the target takes bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The piercing damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage and healing increase by 1.

You generate an arc of static electricity above you, allowing you to ride air currents and descend gracefully, though it doesn't provide actual flight. During this spell's duration, you can glide as a single action that has the move trait. When you glide, you move 5 feet down and 25 feet through the air, though you can control the direction you travel. As long as you spend at least 1 action gliding each round and haven't yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn. At the GM's discretion, strong winds might affect your movements. If the spell ends while you're in the air, you fall normally.

Select an elemental trait: air, earth, fire, metal, water, or wood. Elemental zone gains the trait you chose. You imbue the area with the raw energy of that element, creating a zone that emits and amplifies magic of that type. The temperature might suddenly rise or fall, a storm cloud might form, and so on. Spells with the chosen elemental trait cast against creatures in the zone get a +2 status bonus to one damage type the spell deals based on the chosen trait: bludgeoning or electricity for air, bludgeoning for earth, fire for fire, electricity or slashing for metal, bludgeoning or cold for water, and bludgeoning or vitality for wood. The caster chooses one type to add the bonus to if the spell deals more than one eligible type. This bonus is halved if the spell didn't use a spell slot (such as a cantrip, focus spell, or innate spell).

The zone has no effect on the spell if the spell doesn't deal any damage of an eligible type.

Heightened (+2) The status bonus increases by 1.

You specify a trigger and a message up to 25 words long. When the specified trigger occurs within 30 feet of the target, illusory text of your message circles the target accompanied by a disembodied voice. You can choose a language you know for the text and speech, and can choose what the voice sounds like. Once the message is completed, the spell ends.

Heightened (4th) You can add a simple sensory component to emphasize the message, such as an odor, visual effect, or physical sensation. This addition is obviously illusory and part of the message, lasting only while the message is being read.

Heightened (6th) As 4th rank, but you can choose how many times the spell repeats the message before it ends; there is no limit to the number of repetitions.

You forge a bond between yourself and the target, enabling you to feel each other's emotions. You and the target can communicate empathetically, sharing emotions, at a distance of up to 1 mile.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 4 willing creatures, and the duration increases to 8 hours.
